Name: Combined Girl Mod
Author: Onmyoujin
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]

This mod is a collection of portrait and sprite replacements from various other mods that all convert male villagers to female versions.  I've added dialogue replacements to go along.  The dialogue changes are my own and are a bit rough; please feel free to provide feedback where you find issues so I can improve the mod for future releases.

The characters that can be replaced are:

[list]
[*]Alex 
[*]Elliott
[*]Harvey
[*]Sam
[*]Sebastian
[*]Shane
[*]Willy
[*]Wizard
[/list]
They can be modified or replaced in any combination using the config.json file generated after first launch with the mod active.  Consult the README.txt for a list of all available configuration options.

The majority of the art and sprite assets used in this mod are not my own; I have only provided the dialogue changes as well as general coding to convert some of these mods to Content Patcher compatible versions.  I have made a few small edits to sprites where necessary.

[size=5]Translation Support
[/size]
This mod has i18n translation support.  For details, consult the [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Translation]SMAPI[/url] or [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide.md#translations]Content Patcher[/url] documentation.  If you are interested in being a translator, please make a post or send me a direct message.

Completed Translations:

[list]
[*]German - Psychochicken80
[*]Chinese - Zhanglan1999, KuroameEdamame
[*]French - Azurys
[*]Portuguese - Kadomine
[*]Spanish - Intermarche
[*]Russian - theRealDuda
[/list]
Additional translators are needed for the following languages.  Translators will be expected to have a conversational level of skill in English as well as fluency in one or more of the following languages:[list]
[*]Hungarian
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Turkish
[/list]Native speakers are preferred, but it's not a strict requirement.  No programming experience or skill is required.
